verdict.rationale: Neon is documented as open-source Postgres that you reach with any standard Postgres client (psql, DBeaver), can run locally, and pairs with S3-compatible object storage. Data therefore sits in open, portable formats and the platform can be self-hosted if you leave. However, the pack never documents an export, dump or migration-out feature, so actually extracting everything depends on generic Postgres tooling. Missing for 10: a documented export or pg_dump workflow, coverage of exporting auth/functions/storage data, migration-off guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
